title: 英文情境短劇 EP3：英文會議不再插不上話（JV Tutor Corner）

xinyi.appearance: shoulder-length wavy dark chestnut brown hair, almond eyes, heart-shaped face, slim build
xinyi.style: light grey tailored blazer over a white blouse, grey trousers

yuqing.style: black tailored blazer over an ivory silk blouse, thin gold necklace

hyunjun.style: light blue oxford shirt with rolled sleeves, navy chinos

shots.label: 英文情境短劇 EP3
shots.phrase: 英文會議想發言，卻插不上話？

shots.prompt: standing at the head of the table in a bright glass-walled meeting room of a modern office, holding a tablet
shots.motion: she looks around the table and opens the meeting

shots.prompt: standing at the head of the table in a bright glass-walled meeting room of a modern office, confident and composed
shots.motion: she speaks to the team with a small nod
shots.line: Okay, let's get started. First, the product launch date.
shots.translation: 好，我們開始吧。第一項：產品上市日期。

shots.prompt: sitting at the meeting table in a bright glass-walled meeting room of a modern office, laptop open, serious expression
shots.motion: he leans forward and explains his concern
shots.line: I think we need two more weeks for testing.
shots.translation: 我覺得測試還需要兩週。

shots.prompt: sitting at the meeting table in a bright glass-walled meeting room of a modern office, laptop open, raising her hand slightly, polite but determined
shots.motion: she raises her hand slightly and speaks up
shots.line: Sorry, can I jump in here?
shots.translation: 不好意思，我可以插個話嗎？

shots.label: 今日句型 1
shots.note: 想發言先打聲招呼，比直接打斷有禮貌
shots.line: Sorry, can I jump in here?

shots.prompt: standing at the head of the table in a bright glass-walled meeting room of a modern office, open inviting gesture
shots.motion: she gestures with an open hand, inviting her to speak

shots.prompt: sitting at the meeting table in a bright glass-walled meeting room of a modern office, laptop open, calm and confident
shots.motion: she speaks calmly, looking at her colleague
shots.line: I see your point, but two weeks might be too long.
shots.translation: 我懂你的意思，但兩週可能太久了。

shots.label: 今日句型 2
shots.note: 先肯定對方，再提出不同意見
shots.line: I see your point, but two weeks might be too long.

shots.prompt: sitting at the meeting table in a bright glass-walled meeting room of a modern office, laptop open, thoughtful, then agreeable
shots.motion: he thinks for a moment, then nods
shots.line: Fair enough. Maybe we can test the key features first.
shots.translation: 有道理。也許可以先測主要功能。

shots.prompt: standing at the head of the table in a bright glass-walled meeting room of a modern office, decisive smile
shots.motion: she wraps up the discussion with a decisive nod
shots.line: So, to sum up: we test the key features first and launch on time.
shots.translation: 所以總結一下：先測主要功能，照原訂時間上市。

shots.label: 今日句型 3
shots.note: 會議尾聲收斂結論，大家就知道下一步
shots.line: So, to sum up: we test the key features first.

shots.prompt: sitting at the meeting table in a bright glass-walled meeting room of a modern office, laptop open, smiling with relief
shots.motion: she smiles, nods and closes her laptop as the meeting ends

shots.label: JV Tutor Corner
shots.phrase: 商用英語會議表達技巧
shots.translation: 開場、表達意見、反對與折衷、收斂結論
shots.note: 線上課程．實際演練會議情境
